title: Digital Simulation of Non-Hermitian Knotted Bands on Quantum Hardware
summary: Knots and links represent a fundamental motif of non-local connectivity that permeates the physical sciences from string theory to protein folds. While spectral braiding has been explored in two-band non-Hermitian models across various platforms, its direct simulation and characterization on programmable quantum hardware, particularly beyond two strands, remains a formidable challenge due to the limitations of variational optimization in these systems.
